evidence_strength: moderate (good local cover crop evidence; limited local N and water-saving evidence)
justification: Cover crops reduce bare soil and add organic matter inputs, and legumes fix nitrogen that can reduce fertilizer needs for the following crop. A rye cover tested at the NRCS Fallon center showed excellent winter hardiness and weed suppression.
tradeoffs: Cover crops use water in an arid system; terminating before seed set limits this | Corn silage is water-intensive and may not work every year at Fallon | Hairy vetch showed variable emergence and winter survival (60-100%) in the Fallon study
